whatChanged.headline: OpenAI Says It Is Bringing Nvidia CPUs Into Production. Why Do AI Agents Need Them?
whatChanged.headlineZh: OpenAI 称正将英伟达 CPU 投入生产环境：AI 智能体为什么需要它？
intro: On October 27, 2026, Oracle and Nvidia announced that Nvidia's Vera CPUs and Vera Rubin NVL72 systems were generally available through Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). OpenAI, an early Vera customer, said it was bringing the CPUs into production for the sandboxes where its AI agents run code and tools.

The interesting part is the type of chip. AI spending usually centres on GPUs. But when an agent searches files, runs a script or checks a result, other processors also determine how quickly the job finishes.
introZh: 2026 年 10 月 27 日，Oracle 和英伟达宣布，Oracle Cloud Infrastructure（OCI）开始提供 Vera CPU 和 Vera Rubin NVL72 系统。作为早期使用者，OpenAI 表示，正把 Vera CPU 投入生产环境，用来支持 AI 智能体运行代码和工具的沙盒。
这次值得注意的是 CPU。AI 算力投资通常围绕 GPU 展开，但当智能体查找文件、执行脚本、检查结果时，CPU 的速度同样会影响任务完成时间。

sections.heading: What happens between two AI answers?
sections.headingZh: AI 两次回答之间，还发生了什么？
paragraphs: A GPU is particularly good at the large parallel calculations used to train and run AI models. An agent, however, often works in a loop: ask the model what to do, call a tool, run code or retrieve information, then send the result back to the model.

Those intermediate steps can be CPU-intensive. If a tool call takes too long, the GPU may have to wait before it can process the next model request. A faster model alone cannot remove every delay in that workflow.
paragraphsZh: GPU 擅长训练和运行 AI 模型所需的大规模并行计算。但智能体完成一项任务时，往往要反复循环：先让模型决定下一步，再调用工具、执行代码或查找资料，然后把结果送回模型。
这些中间步骤很多都依赖 CPU。如果工具执行得慢，GPU 可能只能等着下一次模型调用。模型本身再快，也无法消除整个流程里的所有等待。

sections.heading: Who is already using Vera CPUs?
sections.headingZh: 谁已经开始使用 Vera CPU？
paragraphs: Oracle says its new OCI Compute offering uses Nvidia Vera CPUs designed for these tasks. It also says customers can scale CPU and GPU resources separately, rather than adding more of both whenever one becomes a bottleneck. Oracle's Acceleron technology is intended to isolate workloads, including environments running untrusted AI-generated code.

The joint announcement quotes OpenAI's compute CTO, Uday Ruddarraju, saying the company is bringing Vera into production on OCI to support agent sandboxes at scale. This is a concrete reported use, although the release provides no independent before-and-after measurement of OpenAI's speed or costs.
paragraphsZh: Oracle 表示，OCI 新推出的 Vera CPU 计算服务专门支持这类任务，并允许客户分别扩展 CPU 和 GPU 资源，避免某一环节需要更多算力时，另一环节也被迫跟着扩容。Oracle 还表示，Acceleron 可为运行不受信任的 AI 生成代码的工作负载提供硬件级隔离。
在联合公告中，OpenAI 计算业务首席技术官 Uday Ruddarraju 表示，公司正将 Vera CPU 用于 OCI 上的生产环境，以支持大规模智能体沙盒。不过，公告没有提供经过独立验证的 OpenAI 实际提速或成本节省数据。

sections.heading: Can customers use Vera CPUs everywhere yet?
sections.headingZh: 所有地区都能立刻使用 Vera CPU 吗？
paragraphs: The companies describe Vera CPUs as generally available on OCI. Oracle's separate product announcement adds an important practical detail: Vera CPU instances will be available in selected regions during this quarter. The much larger, multi-gigawatt Vera Rubin expansion is a plan, not capacity already delivered.
paragraphsZh: Oracle 和英伟达将 Vera CPU 描述为已正式提供的产品。但 Oracle 的另一篇产品公告补充说，相关实例会在本季度陆续于部分地区开放。至于更大规模、以吉瓦为单位的 Vera Rubin 扩建，目前仍属于计划，不能算作已经交付的算力。

whatChanged.ending: The next AI bottleneck may be the time an agent spends doing work between model calls.
whatChanged.endingZh: 未来影响 AI 任务速度的瓶颈，可能藏在两次模型调用之间。

sources.name: Oracle and NVIDIA joint announcement (27 Oct 2026)

stayCurious.categoryZh: 新加坡 / 建筑 / 历史
stayCurious.headline: Why Are Singapore's Black-and-White Houses Painted Black and White?
stayCurious.headlineZh: 新加坡的黑白洋房，为什么偏偏刷成黑白两色？
intro: Among Singapore's greenery, you can still find old bungalows with bright white walls and dark timber frames. They look carefully colour-coordinated, but the original contrast had a practical explanation.
According to the Urban Redevelopment Authority's conservation handbook, the black coating helped protect exposed wood, while the white came from limewashed walls.
introZh: 新加坡的绿树间，还藏着不少白墙、黑色木框的老洋房。它们看起来像精心搭配过颜色，但最初的黑白对比有实际用途。
新加坡市区重建局（URA）的建筑保护手册解释：黑色涂层用于保护外露木材，白色则来自墙面的石灰涂料。

sections.heading: Why were the timber frames painted black?
sections.headingZh: 为什么木框要刷成黑色？
paragraphs: URA's Conservation Technical Handbook, Volume 7, explains that many early black-and-white bungalows used exposed timber frames with plastered masonry panels between them. Builders coated the timber in black tar-based paint, also described as bituminous or creosote paint. It was used for preservation, resistance to pests and waterproofing. The infill walls were finished in white limewash. Together, the materials produced the striking two-tone appearance.
This describes historical construction methods, not a recommendation to apply old tar or creosote coatings to buildings today.
paragraphsZh: URA 的《建筑保护技术手册》第七册解释，许多早期黑白洋房采用外露木框架，框架之间填上砖石墙体，再抹灰处理。工匠会在木材上涂黑色焦油类涂料，也称沥青漆或杂酚油漆，用于防腐、防虫和防水。墙体则刷白色石灰涂料，于是形成了醒目的黑白对比。
这是对当时建筑工艺的说明，并不意味着今天修缮房屋也应该使用旧式焦油或杂酚油涂料。

sections.heading: How did these houses cope with tropical weather?
sections.headingZh: 这些房子怎样适应热带天气？
paragraphs: The architecture also tells a story of adaptation. The style drew on Anglo-Indian bungalows and incorporated features of local Malay kampong houses, including raised floors. Raised floors, generous roof overhangs, deep verandahs and shutters helped deal with heat, heavy rain and airflow before modern air-conditioning.

In Wessex Estate, for example, the National Heritage Board says British-built black-and-white buildings from the 1930s housed personnel working at nearby military installations. Elsewhere, these homes accommodated colonial officials and company staff. Their history is tied to colonial privilege as well as architectural ingenuity.
paragraphsZh: 这种洋房借鉴了英属印度的平房风格，也吸收了本地马来甘榜住宅的特点，例如架高地板。架高的地板、宽大的屋檐、深阳台和百叶窗，都有助于应对炎热、暴雨与通风需求。在空调普及前，这些设计尤其重要。
例如，国家文物局资料记载，Wessex Estate 的一批黑白建筑从 1930 年代开始兴建，用来安置附近军事设施的英国人员。其他地区的洋房则曾供殖民地官员或企业职员居住。它们既体现了热带建筑的巧思，也留下了殖民时期的社会印记。

sections.heading: Should every old bungalow be painted black and white?
sections.headingZh: 每栋老洋房都应该刷成黑白色吗？
paragraphs: URA warns that the colour scheme has sometimes been applied to historic buildings that never originally had it. Even some government-designed colonial bungalows used other colours or construction methods. Conservators therefore examine historic paint layers rather than assuming that every old house should be repainted in the familiar palette.
paragraphsZh: URA 特别提醒：后来有人把黑白配色用到原本没有这种设计的历史建筑上，反而掩盖了真实风貌。即使是殖民政府兴建的洋房，也并非每栋都采用黑白色。因此，修复建筑时需要研究原有的涂料层和建造方式，不能只照着大家熟悉的外观重刷。

stayCurious.ending: The colours tell you something about how the house was built, and the climate it was built to live in.
stayCurious.endingZh: 这两种颜色，记录着一栋房子当初怎样建造，又怎样适应新加坡的天气。
